pages.title: Introduction
pages.description: Vivera is a skill pipeline that guides AI coding agents from idea and design through plan approval, TDD, debugging, verification, and a debt sweep.

pages.title: Repository Structure
pages.description: An annotated file tree of the repository, plus where the TinyFish rules live and how the skill installs through symlinks into the repo.

pages.title: Quick Start & Installation
pages.description: One install.sh command installs the skill package into every detected agent tool, and --check verifies the result through its exit codes.

pages.title: Execution Lifecycle
pages.description: Requests are classified as Spike, Bounded, or Architectural, then pass brainstorming, plan approval, and verification gates before a debt sweep.

pages.title: Execution Model: Subagent-First, Proportional Fan-Out
pages.description: The parent agent splits work into small verifiable chunks, sizes the subagent batch to the disjoint chunks (inline, 2 to 4, at most 15), then gathers and synthesizes their reports.

pages.title: Confirmations Without Typing
pages.description: Each human decision gate is asked through the agent tool's own question tool with ready-made options, so an answer is a tap or an Enter.

pages.title: Deep Research Workflow
pages.description: When a choice cannot be settled from the codebase, a cited research report is written between the spike and the implementation plan.

pages.title: Executing an ultra-plan/v1 Plan
pages.description: scripts/ultra-plan-runner.mjs parses plan frontmatter, validates the task DAG, skips idempotent tasks, runs each step, and records failures in a ledger.

pages.title: Plan Mirroring: Obsidian and GitHub Issues
pages.description: Plans are copied one way to Obsidian and GitHub issues, and an issue body is the plan text byte for byte plus a trailer with id, status, and hash.

pages.title: Plan Checklist (the to-do list)
pages.description: The to-do list is a checklist in the plan file, owned by the parent agent, and each checked item cites its command, exit code, and result.

pages.title: Pull Request Delivery & Batch Merge
pages.description: Each session ends in a pull request on its own branch, git writes stay with the parent, and a PR registry merges sessions in dependency order.

pages.title: Mermaid Rendering
pages.description: Diagrams are rendered to SVG locally with pinned mermaid-cli v12 before each commit, because the CI workflow runs only on manual dispatch.

pages.title: Trigger Snippets
pages.description: Copy-paste prompts in snippets/ for the six workflow entry points, such as brainstorm, plan, and debugging, each with a short keyword.

pages.title: Vault Indexing & Knowledge Graph Verification
pages.description: Contracts, scripts, and gates that build a knowledge graph of the local Obsidian vault and archived conversations from structural and semantic layers.

pages.title: Plan Lifecycle Audit & Task Completion
pages.description: One script reports plan status counts, and another ticks plan steps only for tasks a runner log shows as PASSED or SKIPPED-IDEMPOTENT.

pages.title: Validation & Quality Checks
pages.description: The local validation suite checks frontmatter, master file integrity, token budget, symlinks, templates, scripts, and Mermaid syntax.

pages.title: Companion Templates
pages.description: Templates in templates/ for intent locks, specs, plans, and other planning artifacts, each of which must embed at least one Mermaid diagram.

pages.title: Examples
pages.description: Filled-in walkthroughs in examples/, including a full pipeline run on a REST endpoint, a deep research report, and a knowledge-graph viewer demo.

pages.title: The Vivera Glossary
pages.description: A short table that maps Harvest Moon: Back to Nature terms, such as the Blue Feather and the Harvest Sprites, to real pipeline concepts.

pages.title: Full Vivera Glossary

pages.title: The Harvest Sprites
pages.description: The seven Harvest Sprites from Harvest Moon: Back to Nature, each with its portrait, game traits, and fixed subagent role in Vivera.

pages.title: graphify Integration Integrity
pages.description: Two scripts that detect a stale graphify block in AGENTS.md and report when graphify install overwrites the OpenCode graphify plugin.

pages.title: graphify Integration Runbook
pages.description: A runbook for graphify v0.9.73 with figures measured on one Linux machine on 2026-10-01, including the cloud-only LLM backend constraint.
